summary:
ByteCore is an interplanetary mission control and flight simulator grounded in authentic orbital mechanics and NASA aerospace standards, supporting both synchronized multiplayer and solo operations.

The platform unites four specialized duty consoles across a real-time WebRTC collaborative bridge: Commander, Propulsion Engineer, Science Specialist, and Telecommunications Officer. Crews design missions to the Moon, Mars, Europa, and 16-Psyche by balancing payload mass, power budgets, and qualification testing (NASA-STD-7001B). During launch, operators handle pitch gimbal alignment, Max-Q throttle control, and 45-second consensus-voted flight anomalies, backed by scientific mishap debriefs when systems fail.

Crucially, ByteCore incorporates an interactive Space Flight Academy with five foundational training modules: Tsiolkovsky Delta-V equations, Hohmann transfer orbits, inverse-square solar irradiance (1/r²), DSN telecom link budgets, radiation shielding, and SWaP-C engineering trade-offs. This allows operators to master core principles before flight, turning theoretical astrophysics into an engaging, collaborative learning experience.
details:
ByteCore is an interplanetary space mission control and flight simulator grounded in authentic orbital mechanics and NASA aerospace standards, supporting both solo and multiplayer modes.

  • How It Works: Operators design missions to the Moon, Mars, and asteroids either solo or in synchronized 4-player crews via WebRTC (Commander, Propulsion & Power Engineer, Science Specialist, Comms Officer). Teams balance the Tsiolkovsky rocket equation (Δv\Delta vΔv), power margins, TVAC chamber qualifications, and DSN telecom throughput. During launch, crews steer pitch gimbal corridors, throttle through Max-Q dynamic pressure, and resolve 45-second consensus-voted flight anomalies.
  • Benefits & Intended Impact: Transforms complex astrophysics and aerospace trade-offs into an accessible, collaborative experience to inspire students toward STEM and space exploration careers.
  • Tools & Technologies: Developed with TypeScript, React 18, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Zustand for reactive state management, and WebRTC (PeerJS) for serverless real-time multiplayer synchronization.
  • Creativity: Unlike conventional space games where a single player controls everything, ByteCore enforces specialized duty station interdependency. Subsystem flaws trigger a dynamic crash sequence followed by a scientific mishap debrief explaining root causes and actionable engineering fixes.
  • Factors Considered: Physical fidelity benchmarked against NASA datasets, stutter-free mobile responsiveness on any smartphone, and complete English/Turkish bilingual localization.
